newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to sell up 35 pct of Endesa.
newsitem.headline: Spain to sell up 35 pct of Endesa.

text.p: The Spanish government said on Thursday it had approved the sale of up to 35 percent of electrical company Endesa.

The sale will include a retail tranche "of around 60 percent to which a discount of around four percent will be offered" Industry Minister Josep Pique told a news conference after the regular weekly Cabinet meeting.
He added that for employers this discount would be around 10 percent.
The offer will involve a maxiumum of 360 million shares with a nominal value of 200 pesetas.
Of the remaining 40 percent of the sale, 10 percent will be directed to Spanish institutional investors, and 30 percent to international investors, Pique said.
The Industry Minister also announced a preliminary calendar for the sale.
